why.description: Helloopass OS provides infrastructure to communities (unions, NGOs, distributors, diaspora) that integrate their members. Communities create their own closed loops to trade among themselves and connect to other closed loops.
why.excerpt_text: « The Helloopass points/voucher system allows community members to conduct transactions within a closed loop without requiring an e-money license, as funds are not refundable to buyers but only to authorized merchants. »

process.title: Accreditation
process.description: Become the next Helloopass exclusive partner. Our process is designed to be fast, rigorous, and fully transparent.

steps_data.title: Form
steps_data.desc: Fill out your initial request online, specifying your territory of interest.

steps_data.title: Review
steps_data.desc: Our expansion committee analyzes your profile, experience, and local market viability.

steps_data.title: Interview
steps_data.desc: Strategic video call with our regional directors to validate alignment.

steps_data.title: Contract
steps_data.desc: Sending the Master Franchise contract draft adapted to your national legislation.

steps_data.title: Signature
steps_data.desc: Secure electronic signature and payment of the initial reservation deposit.

steps_data.title: Activation
steps_data.desc: Full access to the OS, marketing kit handover, and start of the intensive training cycle.
